item.description: All students who registered for today's UofWaterloo BCC contest are asked to go to the library immediately following homeroom announcements. item.title: A message from Mr. Warner:
item.description: The junior girls' basketball team is very excited to host the EOSSAA AA Basketball Championships this coming Tuesday, November 17th. They can't wait to represent STA on their home court in front of the best fans who make the most noise in Prescott Russell! The schedule will be out soon. Please come out and support the girls and get loud STA!!!
